prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic poolside resort portrait with soft golden-hour influence and natural detail.
prompt.main_subject: An adult red-haired woman with fair freckled skin, hair in a high messy bun, calm direct gaze, minimal makeup, a fine-line flower tattoo on the inner left forearm, and a small script tattoo on the ribcage. She wears a mint-green triangle bikini set, chunky gold chain, and delicate bracelet.
prompt.composition_elements: Recline gracefully on a wicker lounge chair with beige cushion, left hand against cheek/temple, right arm relaxed, legs extended and crossed at ankles. Poolside resort with turquoise water, additional loungers, thatched umbrella edge, beige stucco arches, palms, and clear blue sky. Sharp face and upper-body focus, gentle background blur.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural daylight with golden-hour influence, soft sunlight filtered through straw umbrella, gentle shadows, warm inviting peaceful vacation-leisure mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm DSLR, f/2.8, ultra-photorealistic high-definition detail, vibrant natural blue-green and warm skin tones, realistic tattoos, wicker, fabric, water, and architecture texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-photorealistic portrait of an adult red-haired woman with fair skin and natural freckles, hair in a high messy bun, calm direct gaze, minimal makeup, a fine-line flower tattoo on her inner left forearm and a small script tattoo on her ribcage. She wears a mint-green triangle bikini set, chunky gold chain necklace, and delicate gold bracelet, reclining on a wicker lounge chair with beige cushion, left elbow bent and hand resting against cheek/temple, right arm relaxed, legs extended and crossed at the ankles. Set her beside a luxurious turquoise pool with loungers, thatched umbrella edge, beige stucco resort architecture, arched balconies, palms, and clear blue sky. Natural daylight with golden-hour influence, soft filtered sunlight, gentle shadows, 50mm DSLR, f/2.8, sharp face and upper body, slight depth-of-field blur, warm peaceful vacation elegance.
